Only three source files name the `PlanLimits` type. I searched the whole tree for `PlanLimits` and excluded `node_modules` and `.next`.

- `src/config/plan-limits.ts` declares the `PlanLimits` interface. It also uses the type in `PLAN_LIMITS: Readonly<Record<PlanId, PlanLimits>>` and in the return type of `getPlanLimits`. The new required `quota` field has to be added to the interface and to every plan entry in `PLAN_LIMITS`.
- `src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx` imports `type PlanLimits` and uses it for the `limits: PlanLimits` prop.
- `src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts` imports `type PlanLimits` and uses it in the return type of `usePlanLimits()`.

Every other match is a call to `getPlanLimits(...)` or `wouldExceedLimit`, or a mention in a comment or in `corpus-manifest.json` or the `scripts/` files. Those never name the type, so they are out of scope. The tests only call `getPlanLimits` and don't name the type either.

ANSWER: src/config/plan-limits.ts, src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx, src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts
